svg.text: Radar-smoke plays on the three busiest maps: what the smoke returned, and where the radar ship sat
Destroyer smokes only. Team-normalized: own spawn at the bottom. Blue = Top 6, orange = Rest. Association only.
Row 1. Each smoke: line = laid path, dot size = damage dealt from concealment, black ring = a cap not ours was taken while it stood.
Sleeping Giant: cap taken 8 of 23, mean 21k concealed damage
Hotspot: cap taken 11 of 16, mean 19k concealed damage
Mountain Range: cap taken 4 of 9, mean 12k concealed damage
Row 2. Radar ship position (at the smoke snapshot): dot size = enemy ships its radar lit up (hollow = none). Thin line = to the cap it covered.
Sleeping Giant: 35 enemy ships lit by 29 radar runs
Hotspot: 24 enemy ships lit by 25 radar runs
Mountain Range: 16 enemy ships lit by 15 radar runs
